release_notes:
Experimental Taobao 10.66.30 patch bundle for Morphe Manager 2 / Patcher 2.

Includes (all experimental, disabled by default):
- Native DinamicX English labels: 108 exact-match Chinese UI strings (4 base hooks)
- Optional extended DinamicX subclass coverage (24 further TEXT-attribute hooks)
- Native English string resource lookups without protocol locale overrides
- Japanese region English picker (bundled fallback)
- Japanese region English picker (server locale model)

Real Taobao 10.66.30 APK: 595,518 original methods checked;
only four base DinamicX text hooks changed with STRIP_SAFE.
An independently validated separate extension affects exactly
24 additional subclass TEXT-attribute handlers (28 hooks combined,
0 unrelated method changes). APK v1/v2/v3 verification passed.
An Android 15 synthetic fixture confirms the four BASE hooks; the
extra subclass paths have NOT been Android runtime-tested.

IMPORTANT: Real Taobao UI English, Account, login, server and
anti-tamper functionality remain UNVERIFIED/UNFIXED. Do not treat
successful APK builds as live translation proof. Use STRIP_SAFE.
The two JP-picker experiments must be enabled together.
Repackaged APKs have a different signer than official Taobao.
No OCR/overlays or proprietary APK binaries are shipped.
